intro: Trying to find undergraduate scholarships in Michigan that take financial need into account usually means balancing fit, timing, and effort at the same time. This filtered USA view brings together a focused set of listings so you can compare programs tied to Michigan while keeping need-based eligibility front and center. The rows span areas such as education, arts, community, STEM, medicine, and related subjects, so it is worth scanning beyond your exact major. Award amounts vary by listing, deadlines differ by program, and requirement details are not identical across the set. Many listings appear to have lighter application signals and often no essay, but you should still read each scholarship carefully before you apply.
